CeladonCity_Gym_EventScript_Erika.name: Erika
CeladonCity_Gym_EventScript_Erika.defeatText: Erika: Oh! You have defeated me! You're good.
CeladonCity_Gym_EventScript_Erika.introQuote: Erika: Oh my, I must apologize. I was drowsy. Will you challenge me? I use Grass-type Pokemon.

CeruleanCity_Gym_EventScript_Misty.name: Misty
CeruleanCity_Gym_EventScript_Misty.introQuote: Misty: I'm Misty, the Cerulean Gym Leader! I will not lose to you!

CinnabarIsland_Gym_EventScript_Blaine.name: Blaine
CinnabarIsland_Gym_EventScript_Blaine.introQuote: Blaine: My fiery Pokemon will burn you to ashes! You'll regret challenging me!

DewfordTown_Gym_EventScript_Brawly.name: Brawly
DewfordTown_Gym_EventScript_Brawly.defeatText: Brawly: Dude, you've got me beat. I never thought I'd lose here.
DewfordTown_Gym_EventScript_Brawly.introQuote: Brawly: I've been working up a mean sweat with some intense training! Come on, give me all you've got!

FortreeCity_Gym_EventScript_Winona.name: Winona
FortreeCity_Gym_EventScript_Winona.defeatText: Winona: Beautifully done! You've truly exceeded my expectations.
FortreeCity_Gym_EventScript_Winona.introQuote: Winona: I've never lost to anyone in aerial combat. Let me show you the power of the skies!

FuchsiaCity_Gym_EventScript_Koga.name: Koga
FuchsiaCity_Gym_EventScript_Koga.defeatText: Koga: Your skills are of a different level. I cannot complain about losing.
FuchsiaCity_Gym_EventScript_Koga.introQuote: Koga: Fwahahaha! Koga, master of poisons, is here waiting! You will be my next victim!

MauvilleCity_Gym_EventScript_Wattson.name: Wattson
MauvilleCity_Gym_EventScript_Wattson.defeatText: Wattson: Wahahahaha! You're quite the surprising trainer!
MauvilleCity_Gym_EventScript_Wattson.introQuote: Wattson: Wahahahaha! I've been waiting for you! I hope you're ready!

PewterCity_Gym_EventScript_Brock.name: Brock
PewterCity_Gym_EventScript_Brock.defeatText: Brock: I took you for granted. That was my blunder.
PewterCity_Gym_EventScript_Brock.introQuote: Brock: I can see you are not lacking in confidence. Allow me to show you the true power of rock-type Pokemon!

RustboroCity_Gym_EventScript_Roxanne.name: Roxanne
RustboroCity_Gym_EventScript_Roxanne.defeatText: Roxanne: I see. So I still have a lot to learn.
RustboroCity_Gym_EventScript_Roxanne.introQuote: Roxanne: I became a Pokemon Gym Leader so that I may apply what I learned at the Pokemon Trainer School. I do hope you give me all you've got!

SaffronCity_Gym_EventScript_Sabrina.name: Sabrina
SaffronCity_Gym_EventScript_Sabrina.defeatText: Sabrina: I lost... I never expected to lose.
SaffronCity_Gym_EventScript_Sabrina.introQuote: Sabrina: I had a vision of your arrival. You wish to challenge me? Very well.

VermilionCity_Gym_EventScript_LtSurge.name: Lt. Surge
VermilionCity_Gym_EventScript_LtSurge.defeatText: Lt. Surge: Whoa! Your Pokemon are strong! I was so sure that my Raichu would win!
VermilionCity_Gym_EventScript_LtSurge.introQuote: Lt. Surge: Hey, kid! You wanna challenge me? Fine, bring it!

ViridianCity_Gym_EventScript_Giovanni.name: Giovanni
ViridianCity_Gym_EventScript_Giovanni.defeatText: Giovanni: Hmph! I'm surprised I was beaten by you.
ViridianCity_Gym_EventScript_Giovanni.introQuote: Giovanni: I am Giovanni, the leader of Team Rocket. Don't take me lightly!

AzaleaGymBugsyScript.name: Bugsy
AzaleaGymBugsyScript.defeatText: Bugsy: Whoa, amazing! You really know your stuff. I guess my research isn't complete yet.

BlackthornGymClairScript.name: Clair
BlackthornGymClairScript.defeatText: Clair: ...No! I won't accept this! ...Ohh, fine. You won fair and square.

CianwoodGymChuckScript.name: Chuck
CianwoodGymChuckScript.defeatText: Chuck: Wahahah! A magnificent victory! My training was no match for you!

EcruteakGymMortyScript.name: Morty
EcruteakGymMortyScript.defeatText: Morty: This loss shows me how vast the world is, and how much I still have to learn.

GoldenrodGymWhitneyScript.name: Whitney
GoldenrodGymWhitneyScript.defeatText: Whitney: ...Waaah! You meanie! How could you do that to a cute girl?!

MahoganyGymPryceScript.name: Pryce
MahoganyGymPryceScript.defeatText: Pryce: You have a fire this old trainer had forgotten. I concede defeat.

OlivineGymJasmineScript.name: Jasmine
OlivineGymJasmineScript.defeatText: Jasmine: ...You and your Pokemon are far stronger than I imagined. Thank you.

VioletGymFalknerScript.name: Falkner
VioletGymFalknerScript.defeatText: Falkner: The bird Pokemon I raised so carefully... Darn it! ...You have earned this.

LavaridgeTown_Gym_EventScript_Flannery.name: Flannery
LavaridgeTown_Gym_EventScript_Flannery.defeatText: Flannery: Ow! You got me good! You are tough!
LavaridgeTown_Gym_EventScript_Flannery.introQuote: Flannery: I've got burning hot passion! Let's go!

PetalburgCity_Gym_EventScript_Norman.name: Norman
PetalburgCity_Gym_EventScript_Norman.defeatText: Norman: What an intense battle! You're amazing.
PetalburgCity_Gym_EventScript_Norman.introQuote: Norman: I'm proud that you were able to make it here. I should warn you - I'm tough! I'll use my full strength to battle you!

MossdeepCity_Gym_EventScript_TateLiza.name: Tate & Liza
MossdeepCity_Gym_EventScript_TateLiza.defeatText: Tate & Liza: It's impossible! Our combination was broken apart!
MossdeepCity_Gym_EventScript_TateLiza.introQuote: Tate & Liza: Were you surprised to see us? We'll show you our combination!

SootopolisCity_Gym_EventScript_Wallace.name: Wallace
SootopolisCity_Gym_EventScript_Wallace.defeatText: Wallace: Magnificent! You are an outstanding trainer.
SootopolisCity_Gym_EventScript_Wallace.introQuote: Wallace: The power of water is both beautiful and devastating. I am Wallace!
